content.short: Stella Fantasy is a Web3 game developed by Ring Games, a South Korean blockchain game development firm.
content.description: Stella Fantasy is an anime-styled Web3 game that invites players into a vibrant fantasy world. In this adventure, you recruit and collect diverse characters, upgrade their gear, and grow your Frontier Town as a central base for your squad. As you strive to save Synodia, you'll meet beautiful NFT waifu characters and engage in strategic combat, exploration, and town-management activities that intertwine progression with a compelling narrative across multiple realms, and evolving challenges await.
